dialogue.origin: おはようございます
dialogue.content: Good morning.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you for coming.

dialogue.origin: ではさっそくですが始めたいと思いますが用意は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: Well then, I'd like to get started right away. Are you ready?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm ready.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はじめまして　相談員です　今日はどのような事で来られましたか？
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you. I'm a counselor here. What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: 最近、眠れなくて
dialogue.content: Lately, I've been having trouble sleeping.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 何だか頭も回らなくて、つらいです
dialogue.content: My mind feels foggy, and it's really tough.

dialogue.origin: 眠れず頭が回らないのはとても辛いですよね　眠れなくなってしまったのはいつ頃くらいからですか？
dialogue.content: Not being able to sleep and having a foggy head must be very tough. Around when did you start having trouble sleeping?

dialogue.origin: 6月頃からな気がします
dialogue.content: I think it started around June.

dialogue.origin: ６月頃に何か眠れなくなってしまった心当たりはあるのでしょうか？例えばお仕事関係でとか友人関係でとか。
dialogue.content: Is there anything you can think of that happened around June that might have triggered your sleeplessness? For example, something related to work or your friends.

dialogue.origin: 仕事でのストレスがかなりあって、そのせいだと思います
dialogue.content: I've been under a lot of stress at work, so I think that's the reason.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　お仕事はどのようなお仕事をしているのですか？今もその頃と同じ職場ですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. What kind of work do you do? Are you still at the same workplace as you were then?

dialogue.origin: 子供向けの教育イベントをするNPOで働いています。
dialogue.content: I work for an NPO that organizes educational events for children.

dialogue.origin: 今もその団体で仕事しています
dialogue.content: I'm still working for that organization.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね　職場での人間関係はどのような感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. What are the relationships like at your workplace?

dialogue.origin: 小さな団体で、上司と同僚が3人です。上司がかなりストレスで。
dialogue.content: It's a small organization, with one boss and three colleagues. My boss is a major source of stress.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方がストレスなんですね　それも「かなり」がついていると本当にお辛いのが伝わります
dialogue.content: So your boss is the source of your stress. When you say 'major,' I can really sense how difficult it must be for you.

dialogue.origin: 例えばどんな事がストレスと感じますか？
dialogue.content: For example, what kinds of things do you find stressful?

dialogue.origin: 4月から始めた仕事なんですが、
dialogue.content: I started this job in April, and...

dialogue.origin: 同僚３人とは上手く行っていますか？
dialogue.content: Are you getting along well with your three colleagues?

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 同僚とは問題なくやっています。
dialogue.content: I don't have any problems with my colleagues.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方だけがストレスになってしまっているのですね
dialogue.content: So it's just your boss who has become a source of stress.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方はどんな方ですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of person is your boss?

dialogue.origin: 上司は、仕事の目的はおしえてくれるのですが
dialogue.content: My boss explains the purpose of the work, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: やり方はさっぱり教えてくれず。まるで分からないので、とりあえずこちらから
dialogue.content: ...they don't teach me how to do it at all. Since I have no idea, I've been trying to...

dialogue.origin: 提案しようと、色々と考えながら進めてきたんですが
dialogue.content: ...propose ideas and figure things out as I go.

dialogue.origin: それは困りますよね
dialogue.content: That must be frustrating.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 非常勤のスタッフがかなりいるようで。でもそれが、どれくらい出勤できるのか、何ができるのか、何人いるのかさえも分からず
dialogue.content: There seem to be quite a few part-time staff members. But I don't even know their availability, their skills, or how many of them there are.

dialogue.origin: そのスタッフを手配するのも私の仕事だったりで。
dialogue.content: And arranging those staff is also part of my job.

dialogue.origin: 戸惑いばかりで、仕事が進みません。
dialogue.content: I'm just constantly confused, and I can't make progress with my work.

dialogue.origin: 肝心な部分を知らないと動きたくても動けずそれはストレスですよね
dialogue.content: If you don't know the key details, you can't move forward even if you want to. That must be stressful.

dialogue.origin: それが今もずっと続いてる感じで聴いて貰えない感じですか？
dialogue.content: Does it feel like this situation is still ongoing and that you're not being heard?

dialogue.origin: シロクマ様がスタッフを手配するお仕事だと上司の方はもちろん知っているのですよね？
dialogue.content: Your boss is aware, of course, that it's your job, Ms. Shirokuma, to arrange for the staff, correct?

dialogue.origin: 現場がスタッフみんなバラバラで。事務所で顔を合わせることもタマにしかなく。その時に色々と教えてもらうんですが、
dialogue.content: The staff are all scattered at different sites. We only see each other at the office once in a while, and I try to get information then, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: その時に色々と押し付けられる仕事も多くて、聞きに行くのも嫌です。
dialogue.content: At those times, I also get a lot of extra work dumped on me, so I dread going to ask questions.

dialogue.origin: 同僚は、押し付けられる私を心配して、断わんなよって言ってくれるけど
dialogue.content: My colleagues worry about me getting overloaded and tell me to say no, but...

dialogue.origin: なかなか言えなくて。
dialogue.content: ...but I find it hard to say no.

dialogue.origin: この間は断ったらキレられて。
dialogue.content: The other day, when I did refuse, they blew up at me.

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方　お優しいですね
dialogue.content: Your colleagues sound kind.

dialogue.origin: 私の仕事はちゃんと進めたいので、聞きたいことはたくさんあるけど、話しかけるのも嫌です。
dialogue.content: I want to do my job properly, so I have many questions, but I hate approaching my boss.

dialogue.origin: 最初の関わりで上司には苦手意識がついてしまったかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does it feel like you developed this aversion to your boss from your initial interactions?

dialogue.origin: むしろ最初は尊敬していました
dialogue.content: If anything, I respected them at first.

dialogue.origin: 最初は尊敬していたんですね！
dialogue.content: So you respected them at first!

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 会社にはこの上司に憧れて入社した、とかでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Did you join the organization because you admired this supervisor, perhaps?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、同僚も含め、この組織のしていることが素敵だなと思ったので入りました
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. I joined because I thought what this organization, including my colleagues, was doing was wonderful.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね　素敵と感じた会社に入れて　尊敬してた上司の下で働けて
dialogue.content: I see—so you were able to join an organization you felt was wonderful and work under a supervisor you respected—

dialogue.origin: 蓋を開けたら肝心な事を教えてくれないでは期待していたぶん　がっかりしてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: —only to find, once you started, that they wouldn't teach you the crucial things. Given your expectations, that must be very disappointing.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも上司の方とお話し出来る機会は今まであったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have there been opportunities, even small ones, to talk with your supervisor?

dialogue.origin: たまに事務所で一緒になる時間があれば、その時に聞きたいことを聞くといった程度です
dialogue.content: If we happen to be at the office at the same time, I ask what I need to then—that's about it.

dialogue.origin: 今となっては、そういった時間も、無理な仕事を押し付けてくるからない方がいいです
dialogue.content: Now, I'd rather not have that time, because they just push unreasonable work onto me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　そんな時間が昔はあったのに今では信頼関係が壊れて嫌な気持ちが勝っている感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So you used to have those moments, but now it feels like the trust is broken and the negative feelings have taken over?

dialogue.origin: 上司の方もシロクマ様がわからなくてお仕事が進まないと響くと思うのですがそのあたりは大丈夫なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I would think it would also affect your boss if your work doesn't progress because you don't have the information you need. Is that not an issue?

dialogue.origin: これまで、何とか仕事は進めてきたので、問題になってはいないんだと思います
dialogue.content: I've somehow managed to keep the work moving so far, so I don't think it's become an issue.

dialogue.origin: 今は電話が来るだけで吐き気がします
dialogue.content: Now, just getting a call from them makes me nauseous.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと教えてくれれば回る作業も教えてくれないと回らないですよね？それは上司の責任になると思うのですが問題になっていないんですね
dialogue.content: Tasks that would run smoothly if they taught you properly can't, right? I would think that's the boss's responsibility, but it hasn't become an issue?

dialogue.origin: まわしているので
dialogue.content: Because I'm making it work.

dialogue.origin: 眠れないといろいろなところに支障出て来てしまいますよね　それでもお仕事を一生懸命にまわしているシロクマ様は凄いです
dialogue.content: When you can't sleep, it starts to affect various parts of your life, doesn't it? It's amazing that you're still working so hard to keep things going.

dialogue.origin: もう限界だなと感じています
dialogue.content: I feel like I'm at my limit.

dialogue.origin: いま会社で出来そうな事や眠れるようにするためにしてた事ってありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything you think you could do at work, or anything you've been doing to try to sleep better?

dialogue.origin: できそうなことですか？
dialogue.content: Things I could do?

dialogue.origin: 4月から6月まででも大変だったのにもう12月ですものね　本当に頑張ったんだなって伝わります
dialogue.content: It was already tough from April to June, and now it's December. I can tell you've really been pushing yourself hard.

dialogue.origin: 上司に対してこうすれば気にならなくできそうとか　吐き気を抑えられそうとかです
dialogue.content: Like ways to make your boss less bothersome or to reduce the nausea.

dialogue.origin: ないです。思いつかないです。
dialogue.content: No. I can't think of anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　ご結婚はされていますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you married?

dialogue.origin: はい、しています。
dialogue.content: Yes, I am.

dialogue.origin: されているのですね　ご結婚されていると自分の都合で辞めるとかも出来なくて余計に追い詰められて辛いですよね　結婚生活は順調ですか？
dialogue.content: I see. When you're married, it can be harder to just quit for your own reasons, which can make you feel even more trapped and distressed. Is your married life going well?

dialogue.origin: それなりに、順調です
dialogue.content: It's going well enough.

dialogue.origin: お子さんはいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any children?

dialogue.origin: はい、幼稚園の子が一人います
dialogue.content: Yes, we have one child in kindergarten.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　お仕事がお休みの日はどのようにお過ごしですか？
dialogue.content: I see. How do you spend your days off from work?

dialogue.origin: 家族で買い物に行ったりしています
dialogue.content: We go shopping as a family and such.

dialogue.origin: いいですね　他に気晴らしになる事や趣味はありますか？
dialogue.content: That's nice. Do you have any other ways to unwind or any hobbies?

dialogue.origin: あったらいいんでしょうね。ですが、思い当たらないです。
dialogue.content: It would be nice if I did, but nothing comes to mind.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　家族が寝てからの時間はどう過ごされてますか？
dialogue.content: I see. How do you spend your time after your family has gone to bed?

dialogue.origin: 私も一緒に布団に入ります。眠れないですが。
dialogue.content: I get into bed with them, but I can't sleep.

dialogue.origin: どうしても眠れない時でも布団の中から出ないで頑張っている感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Even when you really can't sleep, do you try to stay in bed and tough it out?

dialogue.origin: 本を読むとかスマホを眺めるとかせずにひたすら寝よう寝ようとして眠れない感じですか？
dialogue.content: So you don't read a book or look at your phone, you just keep trying and trying to sleep, but can't?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。目をつぶって横になっているけど、頭の中は仕事、上司のことでいっぱいな感じです
dialogue.content: That's right. I lie there with my eyes closed, but my mind is just filled with thoughts about work and my boss.

dialogue.origin: それほど上司の事が浮かんで寝れないのですね
dialogue.content: Your boss occupies your thoughts so much that you can't sleep.

dialogue.origin: なにか好きな事ややってみたかったけど出来てない事とかありますか？
dialogue.content: Are there any things you like to do, or things you've wanted to try but haven't been able to?

dialogue.origin: 興味のある事でもいいです
dialogue.content: Even something you're just interested in is fine.

dialogue.origin: 思いつかなくて…
dialogue.content: I can't think of anything...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね　これから探してみようとかは思いますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you think you might want to try looking for something?

dialogue.origin: 頭が回らなくて。楽しいことも楽しめるか自身がないです
dialogue.content: My mind isn't clear. I'm not even sure I could enjoy something fun.

dialogue.origin: あ　ごめんなさい　11時になってしまいました
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry—it's already 11:00.

dialogue.origin: （私は11:30まで大丈夫ですが、いかがですか？）
dialogue.content: (I'm okay until 11:30, if that works for you?)

dialogue.origin: 上司の事一色になっているとなかなか他に頭が回らないですよね
dialogue.content: When your mind is consumed by thoughts of your boss, it's hard to think about anything else, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 休みでも夜中でも関係なく電話やメールが来るんです
dialogue.content: They call and email me regardless of whether it's my day off or the middle of the night.

dialogue.origin: 私も大丈夫ですよ。では続けましょう。
dialogue.content: I'm also available. Let's continue then.

dialogue.origin: なので、何をしていても集中できていない感じです
dialogue.content: So, I feel like I can't concentrate no matter what I'm doing.

dialogue.origin: （わかりました）
dialogue.content: (I understand.)

dialogue.origin: 楽しい事が見つけられなくて、なのに休みでも夜中でも関係なく電話やメールが来るのは拷問に近いですよね。
dialogue.content: Not being able to find anything enjoyable, and on top of that getting calls and emails regardless of days off or late at night—it's almost like torture.

dialogue.origin: 私がシロクマさんでもそれはストレスですよ
dialogue.content: If I were in your shoes, I would be stressed out too.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: You might be right.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ストレスです
dialogue.content: Yes, it's stressful.

dialogue.origin: ご飯はちゃんと食べれていますか？
dialogue.content: Are you able to eat properly?

dialogue.origin: はい、食べられます
dialogue.content: Yes, I can eat.

dialogue.origin: 安心しました
dialogue.content: I'm relieved to hear that.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 眠れない以外では困っている事ありますか？
dialogue.content: Besides not being able to sleep, is there anything else you're struggling with?

dialogue.origin: 眠れない、上司の事以外で。
dialogue.content: Other than sleep and your boss.

dialogue.origin: 頭が回らなくて、人の話とか、メールを理解するとか、難しくなってきて困っています
dialogue.content: My mind is foggy, making it hard to understand conversations or emails, which is troubling.

dialogue.origin: それは困りますよね　それも上司の事が原因でですよね
dialogue.content: That must be difficult. And that's also because of the situation with your boss, right?

dialogue.origin: あとは、咳が止まらないです。
dialogue.content: Also, I have a persistent cough.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 咳ですか？持病などおありなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: A cough? Do you have any chronic conditions?

dialogue.origin: いや、たぶんそれもストレスです
dialogue.content: No, it's probably stress-related.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 転職は考えてはいないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you considered changing jobs?

dialogue.origin: 考えてはいます。ただ、今の仕事が年間契約で。すぐには難しいです。
dialogue.content: I have thought about it. But my current job is on a yearly contract, so it's difficult to do it right away.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　でも考えているのですね　あとどれくらい残っているのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. But you are considering it. How much longer is left on the contract?

dialogue.origin: 4ヶ月です
dialogue.content: Four months.

dialogue.origin: まだ長いですね　今のままだと身体も心配ですよね
dialogue.content: That still feels long. I'm concerned about your health if things continue as they are.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: いろいろ気晴らしや出来そうな事を聴いて　思いつかないと回答が多く感じたのですが例えばお散歩とかアロマなどはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I've asked about various ways to relax or things you could do, and it seems you often answer that you can't think of anything. For example, how about something like taking a walk or trying aromatherapy?

dialogue.origin: アロマ、いいなと思いました
dialogue.content: Aromatherapy... I think that sounds nice.

dialogue.origin: アロマ、いいと思ったんですね！環境を少し変えてみたり気分を変えると新しい世界が見えてくるかなと思ったので聴いてみました。
dialogue.content: So aromatherapy sounds good to you! I asked because I thought that changing your environment or shifting your mood a little might help you see things from a new perspective.

dialogue.origin: そうなれるといいです
dialogue.content: I hope so.

dialogue.origin: アロマはどんな香りがお好きとかありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any favorite scents for aromatherapy?

dialogue.origin: この香り試してみたい！とか
dialogue.content: Or any scents you'd like to try!

dialogue.origin: あまり詳しく知らないのですが、爽やかな感じとか、それから、眠れるのとか試してみたいです
dialogue.content: I'm not very familiar with it, but I'd like to try something refreshing and also something that helps with sleep.

dialogue.origin: 眠れるので有名なのはラベンダーが有名ですよね　あとさっき集中と言ったいたのですが集中に効果があるのはペッパーミントがいいそうですよ
dialogue.content: Lavender is well-known for helping with sleep. And you mentioned concentration earlier; peppermint is said to be effective for that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！
dialogue.content: Oh, really!

dialogue.origin: ペッパーミントは集中したり頭がすっきりするそうです
dialogue.content: Peppermint is said to help with concentration and to clear your head.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。いいですね
dialogue.content: I see. That sounds good.

dialogue.origin: 他にはオレンジスイートやローズマリーやレモンもいいみたいですね
dialogue.content: Apparently, sweet orange, rosemary, and lemon are good too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！
dialogue.content: Oh, really!

dialogue.origin: せっかく良いかも？と思ったもののようなので試す価値はあるかもです
dialogue.content: Since it's something you thought might be nice, it might be worth a try.

dialogue.origin: はい、試してみます
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: ほかに「良いかも？」と浮かぶものは思いつきますか？なんでもいいです
dialogue.content: Is there anything else that comes to mind as potentially good? Anything at all.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい、思いついたらいいんですけど、全くいです
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I wish I could think of something, but I really can't.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね　謝る事はないですよ　大丈夫ですよ　アロマが１つ出て来ただけでも進展だと思います
dialogue.content: I see. There's no need to apologize. It's okay. I think just coming up with aromatherapy is a step forward.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: あと4か月したら今の会社は辞める予定で考えていますか？なんだかんだで続けていそうな感じですか？
dialogue.content: After four months, are you planning to leave your current company? Or do you feel like you might end up staying one way or another?

dialogue.origin: このままなら私が持たないと感じています
dialogue.content: If things stay as they are, I feel like I won't be able to hold on.

dialogue.origin: もう少しストレスが減ったら続けるかもしれないです
dialogue.content: If the stress were reduced a little, I might continue.

dialogue.origin: そうですね　なんとか上司の方が少しづつでも変わってくれればいいですね　急に変わらなくても変わろうとしてくれてる姿が見えればいいですよね
dialogue.content: I agree. It would be good if your boss could change, even just a little. Even if they don't change suddenly, just seeing them try to change would be good, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it would.

dialogue.origin: あ　すみません　また30分たってしまいました
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry. Another 30 minutes have passed.

dialogue.origin: 話してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel after talking today?

dialogue.origin: （そうですね、終わりにしますか？）
dialogue.content: (Right, shall we wrap up then?)

dialogue.origin: とりあえず、アロマをやってみようと思います
dialogue.content: For now, I think I'll try aromatherapy.

dialogue.origin: それで、眠れるようになったらいいなと思います
dialogue.content: I hope that will help me sleep better.

dialogue.origin: ですね　今回このシステムはじめてで　はたして延長がよかったのかもわからず　すみません
dialogue.content: I agree. This is my first time using this system, so I wasn't sure if extending the session was the right thing to do. My apologies.

dialogue.origin: ぜひアロマやってみてください　またばにかあればお話し聴かせて下さい　ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Please do try the aromatherapy. If anything else comes up, I’d be glad to listen. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （たぶん、大丈夫です。今まで、何度か延長しましたが、問題なくできていましたので。）
dialogue.content: (It's probably fine. I've extended sessions several times before without any problems.)

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
